deals.evidence: In 2025, the Rays sold to billionaire Patrick Zalupski for a reported $1.7 billion
deals.headline: Zalupski group completes purchase of the Rays from Stuart Sternberg
deals.summary: A group led by Dream Finders Homes CEO Patrick Zalupski, with Bill Cosgrove and Ken Babby, closed on the purchase after unanimous MLB approval. The club did not disclose the price; Forbes reports $1.7 billion.

deals.evidence: The ballpark – now officially budgeted at $2.361 billion
deals.headline: Hillsborough County and Tampa approve the Rays' $2.36bn ballpark
deals.investor: Hillsborough County and City of Tampa
deals.summary: Definitive agreement for a fixed-roof ballpark on Hillsborough College's Dale Mabry campus: the county contributes $796 million, Tampa $80 million (as an advance), and the Rays about $1.37 billion plus all overruns; the county will own it, with $4 million a year rent and a 35-year use agreement. Opening targeted for 2029.

chief_executive.evidence: Babby, CEO of Fast Forward Sports Group, will be CEO.
chief_executive.name: Ken Babby
chief_executive.title: Chief executive officer

honours.evidence: has appeared in two World Series but is still seeking its first championship

stadium_owner.detail: Tropicana Field is city-owned (City of St. Petersburg) and leased to the Rays; the Rays returned there in April 2026 after hurricane roof repairs. The planned Tampa ballpark (opening targeted 2029) will be owned by Hillsborough County.
stadium_owner.evidence: the lease with St. Petersburg for the city-owned Tropicana Field

wages.source_name: Forbes (estimate), player expenses incl. benefits and bonuses

founded_evidence: The Rays, initially known as the Devil Rays, joined MLB in 1998
name: Tampa Bay Rays
notes: Revenue, operating income and player expenses are Forbes estimates for the 2025 season (the season the Rays played at Steinbrenner Field after Hurricane Milton); valuation is Forbes March 2026. Forbes' 'Price Paid $680M' line for Zalupski is not explained on the page and was not used; the sale price itself was undisclosed and $1.7bn is Forbes' 'reported' figure. Stakes of the individual partners are not disclosed. Founded 1998 = first season (expansion franchise awarded earlier). The withdrawn 2024 St. Petersburg $1.3bn stadium deal (Rays withdrew March 2025) is not recorded as a deal. Not found: legal entity, attendance, kit supplier, jersey patch sponsor, socials.

ownership_summary: Owned since 30 September 2025 by an investment group led by Patrick Zalupski (CEO of Dream Finders Homes; managing partner, control person and co-chair), with co-chair Bill Cosgrove and CEO Ken Babby; the group also includes Dan Doyle Jr., Doug Hertz, Matt Silverman, Robert Skinner, Will Weatherford and Rick Workman. They bought the club from Stuart Sternberg; the price was not disclosed (Forbes reports $1.7 billion). No private equity or other fund holder is on record.
